native_profile: Linux x86_64 GCC 13.3 C++17; signed 64-bit streamsize
defined_behavior: Custom xsgetn receives counts -3, 0, 2 through std::streambuf::sgetn and returns -7, -11, 2.
Positive qualified-base delegation copies AB and leaves cursor at C.
Existing unsigned hook implementations remain reachable through default signed dispatch.
rust_adapter_policy: The explicit signed interface preserves override results.
Rust Read reports InvalidData for negative custom results; unsigned convenience maps negative/error to zero.
Default reads validate nonnegative counts and sufficient output capacity before consuming.
remaining_scope: This probe does not establish configuration-wide parity or arbitrary fpos/seek override state.
Negative base reads and native invalid pointer arithmetic have no defined memory-safe behavior to reproduce.

validation.focused_test_command: cargo test -p rustycad-tkernel --test array_stream_signed_reads --test array_stream_hook_dispatch --test array_stream_integer_putback --test standard_array_stream_buffer
